facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports that Benin's startup label rests on decree 2023-095 and that article 147 of the tax code already gives labelled startups two years of corporate tax and payroll levy exemption, then 50% in year three.
La Marina BJ reports the first startup label session, 2 to 12 December 2024, drew 95 applications and labelled fifteen firms, with the tax exemption applying to labelled startups.

BEN.note: The 2027 finance bill amendment is tabled, not adopted.
No hub, incubator or park stated.
